scope: Independent preparation review only: exact helper, pinned bottle/source, retained native discovery/dry-run and bounded archive inspection. Parent remains sole implementation writer.
disposition: No findings for this exact pkgconf 3.0.8 preparation candidate. This is not installation admission or native pkgconf, compiler/dependency, network-confinement or Claude/OCI qualification.

static_review.guards: Startup and final guard bind the contract, 69 inputs, current mise/Python bytes and helper; qualified shared-state protected() remains active. Formula identity/version/revision/dependencies/keg policy and selected bottle digest are checked before inspection.
static_review.archive_write_set: All 50 actual archive members, regular-file hashes and two internal symlinks match the retained manifest. Independent derivation matches 28 archive-derived public leaves plus opt and linked-keg records, all 30 absent. All 24 necessary parent paths and 23 bootstrap/rack/lock controls match; recorded parents require no directory materialization. The stated rack/staging/keg paths cover additional native install work, which remains unexecuted.
static_review.native_source_contract: Read actual pinned brew dry-run, prefix/bootstrap, pour/link/materialization and current HTTP rewrite code. Native dry-run returns before pour/extract work; bootstrap(true) only reports required prefix work. All 16 selected current source contents match retained SHA256 and Git blobs in the current non-truncated Git tree.
static_review.isolation: The helper creates private config/system/state/data/cache/cwd paths, constructs a minimal child environment, disables hooks/autoinstall/auto-env, and rewrites the relevant metadata/GitHub/GHCR origins to its loopback fixture. Actual requests record one successful formula response followed by two expected metadata failures. URL rewriting and source review do not prove general network confinement.
static_review.failure_propagation: Command return codes are checked against explicit expectations; command timeout/error handling signals and waits for the subprocess group. Main failures retain FAIL, final protected-state failures propagate, and cleanup stops the local server. Actual receipt records all controls and server shutdown completed.
static_review.fresh_session: Private cwd/config and explicit environment prevent dependence on active named-profile state in this dry-run. Profile availability is supported by the separately retained six-command native discovery, not an assumption from this reviewer PATH.
static_review.documentation: docs/vcpkg-toolchains.md:103-116 and task_plan.md:203 limit completion to discovery/preparation, retain fmt validation, identify actual fnox/mise routes and preserve incomplete strict-five research status. Native installation remains separate.

scratch_controls.scope: AST-only inspect/digest/preimage functions with scratch PREFIX and fixtures. No candidate module imports, live-prefix reads or archive extraction.

executed_reviewer_checks.license_text: ISC COPYING member independently read from the pinned archive and compared byte-for-byte with the 468-byte retained selected text.

retained_executions_inspected_not_replay.source_and_bottle_acquisition: Native fnox codex_research/Python receipts both return 0, with verified official metadata/archive and pinned source bindings. No new research ran in this review.

secret_scan_disposition.false_positive: The exact flagged contract input value equals the SHA256 of the retained, Git-blob-verified API source. It is a source content digest.
